acceptance.assertion: Tests cover the observed incomplete legacy release-evidence shapes and deterministically classify each as safely migratable, safely quarantinable, protected, or unknown; unknown cases remain fail-closed and undeleted.
Retention logic proves the active runtime release, configured keep set and rollback-relevant releases cannot be deleted or rewritten by legacy handling.
For known legacy states, repeated unchanged deploys converge without repeating the same unbounded retention warnings; unresolved unknown states remain visible with stable, actionable evidence.
T036 changes repository code/tests/documentation only and performs no deletion, migration or mutation of the live Audiozentrale release store.
Implementation, regression tests, full diff, self-review and required GitHub checks are bound to the same published head; material review findings or red checks block merge.

approval.note: Repository implementation and hermetic tests only. Do not delete or rewrite live release directories under this task; any live cleanup must be separately authorized after exact preimage/readback.

goal: Eliminate repeated Audiozentrale retention warnings from understood legacy release formats while preserving fail-closed deletion, current/rollback release protection and exact evidence binding.
